newsitem.title: GREECE: HOLD GREEK EQUITIES FOR COME BACK-ALICO EUROBANK.
newsitem.headline: HOLD GREEK EQUITIES FOR COME BACK-ALICO EUROBANK.

text.p: Following a 50 percent retracement from recent peaks, Greek equities are bound to recover helped by strong earnings growth and still attractive dividend yields, said Alico Eurobank Fund Management.

"Simply put, the party is not over. We've had a 50 percent retracement in the market and worries on the macro front. But we're seeing a hiatus, not a stall," Alico Eurobank's chief investment officer Alex Pappas told Reuters.

Concerns of a stubborn CPI in the second half and firmer interbank rates are overdone. After a marked improvement during the first half there is a temporary pause in the pace of falling inflation and interest rates, he said.

"One should not miss the big picture -- the improvement in macroeconomic fundamentals has sparked an asset reallocation into equities, driving the market to all-time highs. This has not reversed on a fundamental basis," Pappas said.
"Mutual funds are continuing to see cash inflows. The bourse's retail component is quite calm and more educated nowadays; it tends to see the bottle half-full despite the corrections," he added.
Alico Eurobank has 270 billion drachmas in assets under management and eight funds on the market. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
